headline: Reuters says Russia is fining people for fake AI pictures of bears, after a woman's prank image sent rangers hunting for an animal that did not exist.
score_reason: Light but clear story; same event as C16-03.
importance_line: It shows fake AI images triggering real alarm and fines in a country frightened by deadly bear attacks; the fines are small, and the story duplicates C16-03.
summary: Reuters reports, as relayed by Devdiscourse, that a woman in Russia's Amur region was fined 15,000 roubles ($178) after she used ChatGPT to make a picture of a bear on a local street as a prank, which spread and sent wildlife rangers searching. A similar case in Transbaikal earlier brought a 30,000-rouble fine, and at least 26 people have been killed by real bears since spring.
